paragraphs: KnarrTek sells manufacturing operations software for real-time inventory, production, warehouse, and traceability visibility. The stated problem is that an ERP does not usually capture the real activity happening on the floor. The platform connects inventory movement, production updates, barcode scans, RFID reads, label activity, quality records, job status, and traceability events into one controlled workflow.

Three software packages are listed: BellHawk Online, WIPtracker, and SmartOps24x7. BellHawk Online is described as a browser-based inventory and production tracking system for companies that need barcode scanning, job visibility, and inventory control without a large on-premise installation. WIPtracker is built for manufacturing and warehouse operations that need deeper shop-floor control, on-premise deployment, production tracking, QA workflows, and traceability. SmartOps24x7 uses MilramX-powered rules, alerts, intelligent agents, integrations, and exception monitoring to keep operational data moving.

The site says KnarrTek serves manufacturers, processors, warehouses, distributors, and regulated organizations. Deployment covers cloud, on-premise, and hybrid strategies for organizations that need stronger control over plant-floor records. A compliance note states that KnarrTek does not provide CMMC certification, cybersecurity assessments, legal advice, or compliance certification.

quote.text: Stop guessing what is happening on the shop floor.
